newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mint buys 2,224,000 kg of zinc.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mint buys 2,224,000 kg of zinc.

text.p: The U.S. Mint said Thursday it purchased 2,224,000 kg of special high grade zinc from five companies at an average price of $1.1574 per kg, for a total cost of $2,567,060.40.
The Mint bought 744,000 kg from Future Resources Inc at an average price of $1.1513 per kg, for a total cost of $856,581.20.
It bought 462,000 kg from Trademet Inc. at an average price of $1.1635 per kg for a total cost of $537,556.80.

It purchased 272,000 kg from Hochschild Partners at $1.1644 per kg and a total cost of $316,716.80; 286,000 kg from Astumet Inc at an average price $1.1614 and a total cost of $332,173.60, and bought 460,000 kg from Phoenixx at a cost fo $1.1465 and a total cost of $524,032.00
